description: The total number of sell-side analysts (integer) covering the peer company (QESID_2) in a pair. This is the TO_ANALYST field from the AnalystNet network.
A proprietary similarity weight (float) representing the business overlap between two companies. This is the STRENGTH field from the BusNet network.

An integer count quantifying the intensity of a directional executive tie, associated with the source company (FROM_QESID) in a relationship. This is the FROM_FREQ field from the ExecutiveNet network.
An integer count quantifying the intensity of a directional executive tie, associated with the target company (TO_QESID) in a relationship. This is the TO_FREQ field from the ExecutiveNet network.
A proprietary similarity weight (float) representing the overlap in geographic exposure between two companies. This is the STRENGTH field from the GeoNet network.

Proprietary similarity weight (float) between two companies based on the text similarity of their 'Management's Discussion and Analysis' (MD&A) sections. This is the STRENGTH field from the MDANet network.
Proprietary similarity weight (float) between two companies based on the text similarity of their 'Risk Factors' sections in filings. This is the STRENGTH field from the RiskNet network.
Number of analysts that cover both the primary and peer company (shared analyst coverage)
Number of executives and board members (current or former) shared between the primary and peer companies
Number of analysts covering the primary company
Number of executives and board members associated with the primary company
Similarity score based on Management Discussion & Analysis (MD&A) filing text, indicating business operation similarity between the two companies
Textual similarity score between the business section filings of the two companies, reflecting how closely related they are based on NLP analysis
Number of executives and board members associated with the peer company
Similarity score or correlation of Risk Factor section text between the primary and peer companies, indicating how similar their disclosed risk language/themes are
Number of analysts covering the peer (secondary) company
The number of sell-side analysts (integer) that cover both companies in a pair. This is the COMMON field from the AnalystNet network.
The number of shared business elements (integer) between two companies, used to calculate business overlap. This is the COMMON field from the BusNet network.
The count of shared executives or board members (integer) that form a directional tie between two companies. This is the COMMON field from the ExecutiveNet network.
The number of shared geographic regions of operation (integer) between two companies. This is the COMMON field from the GeoNet network.
The total number of sell-side analysts (integer) covering the source company (QESID_1) in a pair. This is the FROM_ANALYST field from the AnalystNet network.
A proprietary similarity weight (float) based on text analysis of company filings. This corresponds to the STRENGTH field in the NLPBusNet, MDANet, and RiskNet networks.
